gen-dafont-neon-gf-fresca: Glowing and stamped-tall, Neon grabs the eye with lines that never thin out. Fresca then settles into a modern sans-serif body, short ascenders over big bowls, so a longer passage keeps flowing without snagging.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-funnel-sans: Neon glows like stamped metal, every stroke the same width. Funnel Sans does the opposite job, holding steady stem to curve with a pried-open e, so it handles the quiet sentences while the heading handles the shouting.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-gafata: Gafata reads tall and compact, with short stalks and wide-eyed e shapes. Neon is best at glowing, uniform-stroke display lines with open spacing, while Gafata does its best work in contemporary, businesslike text.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-geist: Vibrant and glowing, Neon looks like stamped metal letters with room between each one. Geist follows with a level, quiet beat and wide openings, so a longer passage settles into solid blocks of words.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-georama: Approachable, this body leaves its c gaping like a pulled-apart bracelet. Neon's pressure-free, ballpoint-plain line weight up top meets Georama's low-rising capitals below, and the two sit together like a loud sign over a friendly counter.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-gidole: Gidole reads clean, its terminals parted like open scissor blades. Neon glows above it with the same neon-tube consistency in every stroke, so the heading and the sans-serif text feel drawn by one steady hand.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-golos-text: Golos Text fills its line with a big x-height. Neon glows and stands tall like stamped metal, while the sans body, built from one stroke width with a widely parted s, feels friendly and contemporary beside it.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: Hedvig Letters Sans reads friendly, its small letters nearly as tall as capitals. Neon's glowing, ruler-and-compass line gives the pair its strongest quality: a vivid heading sitting over a body that stays open and approachable.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-heebo: Vibrant, Neon keeps every curve at full strength with no thinning. The pair's strongest quality is that glow set against Heebo, a sans-serif body with a tall central band and curves that stop short instead of closing in.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-hind-guntur: Hind Guntur reads modern and unfussy, with wide gaps where curves meet stems. And Neon, glowing in the same stamped-metal tall lowercase, gives the pair its strongest quality: uniform strokes that never shift from thick to thin.
